name: sgct
description: The scalable and NDI features wrap proprietary SDKs whose licenses do not permit redistribution. They are off by default and a package built with them must not be handed to third parties. SGCT depends on stb_image/stb_image_write through the stbimage overlay port, which compiles their implementation exactly once for the whole superproject, so a consumer that also links another user of stbimage does not hit a duplicate-symbol/ODR conflict.

calibrator.description: Build the SGCT calibrator application, a standalone tool that renders a test pattern for aligning and calibrating a display cluster

ndi.description: Build SGCT with NDI support. Proprietary SDK, the resulting package cannot be redistributed

scalable.description: Build SGCT with Scalable SDK support. Proprietary SDK, the resulting package cannot be redistributed
